question: As we know from the graduation of micrometer, if we give one full round to thimble, its spindle moves ½ mm forward or backward. Therefore, one part of the thimble is its___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Least count__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Least count__ is the smallest measurement that a micrometer can accurately read.
 
• In a micrometer, giving one full rotation to the thimble moves its spindle forward or backward by 0.5 mm.
 
• The least count is determined by dividing the pitch by the number of divisions on the circular scale.
 
• Micrometers are widely used for precise measurements of dimensions in engineering and manufacturing.
 
• They are highly accurate due to their small least count and finely calibrated scales.
 
• Proper handling and calibration are essential to ensure the accuracy of measurements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pitch:**

 
 
• Pitch is the distance moved by the spindle per revolution of the thimble.
 
• It is a key parameter in micrometer functioning.
 
 
 
• **Lead:**
 
 
• Lead refers to the axial movement of the spindle per revolution of the screw thread.
 
• It determines the precision of the instrument.
